name: Songs of Silence: Crownless King Expansion
summary:
A rogue and his ragtag family of troublemakers carve out a cozy life on the edge of the Silence-ridden Midlands. But comfort rarely lasts... When hungry kingdoms move to feast on what remains of the realm, sharp tongues, light fingers, and highly questionable honor unexpectedly become the Midlands’ last hope.

Join Thorn's lot in both campaign and skirmish, with this Songs of Silence expansion!
